messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: upgrading from shiny-server 0.3.6 to shiny1.1.0001
parts:
In the past I have unsuccessfully tried to upgrade from shiny-server 0.3.6.  The main problem, I think was related to a proxy server making it difficult to access github or use the git protocol to download.  We seem to have fixed that issue.  Now I would like to upgrade. It seems that there used to be instructions on how to uninstall shiny-server 0.3.6 so that it would be possible to install newer versions.  The latest instructions on installation from source do not include those instructions. Is it still necessary? If so, where can I get the previous instructions (a web search has not produced them for me but I may be bad at searching), or if it is not necessary I will proceed with the latest instructions.  

Thanks,

Mike

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: upgrading from shiny-server 0.3.6 to shiny1.1.0001
parts:
Mike,

I recommend that you follow the instructions in this section of Admin Guide:

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#upgrading-from-shiny-server-0.3.x

to uninstall shiny-server 0.3.6, and then go ahead with installing a new version.

Best,
Fereshteh
